text: でも　やっぱり　ガルーラの　ふくろに　はいって　みたーい！

structure.jp: ガルーラの　ふくろに
はいって　みたーい！
structure.en: I want to try getting in!

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.span: はいって　みたーい
patterns.explanation: みる after a て-form verb means to try doing it and see what it is like. はいって みたーい = 'I want to try getting in'.

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on a verb means 'want to do'. Here it is stretched out to sound excited. みたーい = 'I waaant to try'.
